cases.title: Add note button creates and appends note div with textarea
cases.description: When the user clicks the Add note button, a new note is created and appended to the document body as a div element with the class note, containing a visible, empty textarea with data-testid="note-textarea".

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note button create separate notes
cases.description: The application supports multiple rapid clicks on the Add note button, with each click creating a separate note, each containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown Rendering
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown into the textarea, the content is dynamically rendered in real-time in the main display area with proper HTML formatting.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown Handling and Raw Input Display
cases.description: Verify that invalid Markdown does not cause crashes or errors, and instead displays the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the Edit button.

cases.title: Markdown Edit State Persistence
cases.description: Verify that all Markdown changes are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state of the note.

cases.title: Create new note on click and enter initial edit mode
cases.description: When the user clicks the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button") upon app load, a new note is created which immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden.

cases.title: Switch between edit and view modes using the Edit button
cases.description: Users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"). In view mode, the main content area becomes visible and the textarea is hidden, while in edit mode this behavior is reversed.

cases.title: Automatic saving of note state to local storage
cases.description: All changes typed into the textarea should be automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete a note and remove it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Clicking the 'Delete' button (data-testid="delete-note-button") associated with a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and render saved notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: When the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves all saved notes from localStorage using JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')) and dynamically creates a div element with the class note for each stored note, containing a tools div with edit and delete buttons, a main div (data-testid="note-main"), and a textarea (data-testid="note-textarea").

cases.title: Render non-empty notes with main display visible and textarea hidden
cases.description: For stored notes that have content, the application renders their content displayed in the main div, with the textarea hidden by default.

cases.title: Render empty notes with textarea visible and main display hidden
cases.description: For notes that have no content, the application shows the textarea and hides the main div, allowing immediate editing.

cases.title: Display no notes when localStorage is empty
cases.description: If localStorage is empty, no notes are shown on the page.

opinions.feedback: The provided test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover all requirements appropriately without speculatively testing unstated behaviors, and adequately capture multiple distinct operations and error states.
All test cases are well-structured, directly mapped to valid requirements, and fully testable without any blockers or redundancies.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 contains multiple behaviors: creating a note on click, appending it as a div with class note containing a textarea, and supporting multiple rapid clicks. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 contains multiple behaviors: typing Markdown with real-time dynamic rendering in note-main, handling complex and invalid Markdown without crashes, displaying raw input on exit edit mode via the edit button, and persisting changes to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 contains multiple behaviors: creating a note on page load or via click, entering edit mode immediately upon creation (textarea visible, note-main hidden), switching modes via the edit button (view mode shows main and hides textarea, edit mode reverses), and saving changes to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 contains multiple behaviors: deleting a note on clicking the delete button, removing the targeted note from the DOM, and removing the corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 contains multiple behaviors: retrieving and rendering saved notes from localStorage on page load, creating note elements with tools, edit/delete buttons, main display, and textarea, rendering stored content with main visible and textarea hidden by default, showing textarea and hiding main for empty content notes, showing no notes if localStorage is empty, and using JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notes')). Each requirement includes explicitly mentioned abnormal or boundary paths such as invalid markdown handling and empty local storage states.
